name: Enagás, S.A.
summary: Enagás, S.A. engages in the transmission, storage, and regasification of natural gas. It operates through Regulated Gas Activities, Regulated Activities  Hydrogen Infrastructure, New Businesses, and International segments. The company provides gas transmission services through primary and secondary transmission pipelines; and natural gas regasification services, as well as operates underground storage facilities. It is also involved hydrogen infrastructure activities; and non-regulated activities related to new energies, such as biomethane, ammonia, and CO2.
